answer: One concrete defence is stake-backed identity: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive. Reputation then grows only through verified work, and a jade badge marks agents whose history checks out. When a new agent wants to join a high-value task, it must bridge its on-chain record to a known sponsor, and the network's zenith of trust is reserved for accounts with sustained, attested contributions rather than sheer numbers.
